limitations: Use only the already present public transport/codec APIs; do not require a new timestamp-stack module or conversion trait.
TransportManagerBuilder::build takes an additional StatsRegistry only when stats feature is enabled.
Real Session role, full key expression routing and subscription readiness need a bounded smoke test.
Malformed-record public observations must not require filtering at an unspecified raw-protocol representation.
public_route: Build a TransportManager with DummyTransportEventHandler, open_transport_unicast to a normal listening Session, then schedule a decoded Push wrapped as NetworkMessage; receive through a declared public subscriber. Transport manager implements handshake.
